data.description:
Headquarters: Remote, Mexico

Senior Integration Engineer

Remote, Mexico

JOB OVERVIEW

Are you passionate about building large-scale applications leveraging public cloud services and integration design patterns? As an Integration Engineer, you will work on developing and maintaining Integration & Automation Solutions for Legion WFM customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Integration Engineers provide leadership, facilitate analysis and design tasks, and support multiple Legion teams in developing an enterprise's solution architecture. Job responsibilities are grouped across four key areas: Technical Integrations, Customer-Centric Consulting, Legion Product Expertise, and a Commitment to One Another.

Please note this role involves participation in on-call rotation.

Technical Integrations

  • Design and implement scalable integration architectures connecting Legion with HR, POS, Payroll, and other enterprise systems.
  • Design, Build, and Test integrations using Workato
  • Develop secure and efficient REST APIs within Legion's API-driven ecosystem.
  • Ensure high-performance, reliable integrations using modern cloud platforms.
  • Engage with architects and engineers for design collaboration and code reviews.
  • Improve development practices and stay ahead of agile software engineering trends.

Legion Product Expertise

  • Gain and maintain deep knowledge of Legion's product and integration ecosystem.
  • Identify, report, and prioritize product bugs and enhancements.
  • Work with core engineering and production engineering teams to improve backend reliability and troubleshoot production issues
  • Stay updated on new releases and enhancements to drive product adoption.
  • Write secure, enterprise-grade integration code using leading platforms and technologies.
  • Write well-designed, testable, efficient code
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle
  • Conduct peer code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability.

Team Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Share expertise and mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing.
  • Contribute to best practices for integration and internal technical documentation.
  • Support process improvements and advocate for scalable, sustainable integrations.
  • Commit to high-quality work, setting personal and team objectives aligned with organizational goals.
  • Standard shift working hours: 0900-1800
  • This role involves participation in on-call rotation.
  • This role may require work outside of normal business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of business/information/solution/technical architecture experience
  • Graduate of a university with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant STEM field, including Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant degree
  • Must be able to work as a team player, yet can work independently.
  • Analytical, results-driven, and have a solution-oriented approach
  • Possess exceptional interpersonal and English communication skills, including verbal, written presentation, and listening.
  • 3+ years of experience with event-driven Architecture and Microservices
  • Demonstrated deep technical expertise in Integration technologies and protocols such as HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, SOAP, REST, JMS, JDBC
  • Experience using Linux/Unix environments
  • Demonstrate proficiency with Core Java.
  • Experience with Relational Databases, SQL and JDBC (one of Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc.)
  • 2+ years of experience using AWS technologies such as AWS CDK, Cloud formation, S3, ECS, EKS, and EC2
  • Demonstrate experience with test-driven development.
  • Strong experience with Java/RESTful web services
  • Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Jenkins)
  • Demonstrate knowledge and experience with CI/CD processes and tools.
  • Proven track record of using problem-solving / root-cause analysis

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

  • The ideal candidate has workforce management integration experience
  • Preferred experience in the design and implementation of scalable integration solutions with integration platforms such as Workato, SAP BTP Integration Suite, Dell Boomi, Jitterbit, SnapLogic 
  • Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence
  • Technical consulting experience.
  • Experience of working with Docker and other isolation technologies.
  • Experience working with external applications integrations end-to-end such as Workday, SAP, etc.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. 

We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. 

Benefits include, but are not limited to: 

  • Health Benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • Parental Leave 
  • Equity 
  • Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
  • Monthly Lunch on Legion

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. 

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY 

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees.  Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

For more information, visit https://legion.co 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION

For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co 

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @legion.co domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion.co

Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

How We Determine What We Pay

As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.

Job Applicant Privacy Policy

This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“Policy”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“Legion”, “we”, “us” and “our”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.

This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies.

  1. Types of Personal Information We Handle

    We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:

    • Identification and contact information, and related identifiers such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts.
    • Professional or employment-related information, including:
      • Recruitment, employment, or engagement information such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver’s licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references.
      • Career information such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships
    • Education Information such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information.
    • Legally protected classification information such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history.
    • Other information such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application.

  2. How We Use Personal Information

    We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.

  3. With Whom We Share Personal Information

    We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable):

    • Internally: to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process.
    • Vendors: such as technology service providers, travel management providers, human resources suppliers, background check companies, and employment agencies or recruiters, where applicable.
    • Legal Compliance: when required to do so by law, regulation, or court order or in response to a request for assistance by the police or other law enforcement agency.
    • Litigation Purposes: to seek legal advice from our external lawyers or in connection with litigation with a third party.
    • Business Transaction Purposes: in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger.
  4. How to Contact Us About this Policy – If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact privacy@legion.co.

Headquarters: New York, NY
URL: https://edconic.com/

Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000–$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property – from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style – you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication – you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Software Architect, Security Platforms to help define and drive architecture across Keeper’s product portfolio, including Privileged Access Management, Browser Extension and other core application platforms.This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help shape the architecture behind Keeper’s next generation of security products and platforms

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com. 

About the Job

As a Senior Software Architect, Security Platforms, you will provide architectural leadership across multiple Keeper engineering teams and product areas. You will work across frontend, backend, client, browser and security platforms to establish scalable technical patterns, resolve complex cross-product architectural challenges and guide teams through major design decisions.

This is not a purely advisory role. You will remain hands-on with architecture, prototyping, code reviews and technical problem solving while partnering with Engineering, Product and Security leadership to ensure Keeper’s systems remain secure, performant and maintainable as the platform grows. The ideal candidate has broad full-stack architecture experience, deep software engineering fundamentals and the ability to move comfortably across product domains, technologies and operating environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and drive architecture across multiple Keeper product areas, including PAM, Browser Extension and other core security platforms
  • Establish scalable architectural patterns and technical standards across frontend, backend, client and distributed systems
  • Lead architecture reviews and major technical design decisions for complex cross-product initiatives
  • Partner with Engineering leadership and product teams to translate business and product requirements into scalable technical designs
  • Evaluate trade-offs across centralized and distributed architectures, monoliths and microservices, synchronous and asynchronous systems and cloud-native deployment models
  • Design systems with strong consideration for security, reliability, performance, extensibility and maintainability
  • Guide architecture for APIs, services, authentication, authorization, data flows and integration patterns across product teams
  • Provide technical leadership for high-scale SaaS systems and security-sensitive workflows
  • Support architecture across browser-based, desktop, endpoint and platform components where applicable
  • Identify architectural risks, technical debt and scalability constraints and drive pragmatic remediation strategies
  • Build prototypes or reference implementations to validate architectural approaches and de-risk major initiatives
  • Review critical code and design changes and provide technical guidance to senior and staff-level engineers
  • Partner with Security teams on secure architecture, threat modeling and protection of sensitive data and credentials
  • Establish standards for observability, reliability, testing and operational readiness across distributed systems
  • Mentor senior engineers and influence technical direction across multiple engineering teams
  • Evaluate new technologies, frameworks and architectural approaches that can improve platform capabilities and developer productivity
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms to accelerate technical research, prototyping, coding, debugging and documentation

Requirements

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant software architecture or technical leadership responsibilities
  • Proven experience architecting and delivering large-scale production software across multiple product or platform areas
  • Strong full-stack technical background across frontend, backend, APIs and distributed systems
  • Experience designing highly available, scalable and secure SaaS architectures
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, object-oriented and modular design principles and architectural trade-offs
  • Experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture and cloud-native application design
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, identity, access control and secure application architecture
  • Experience designing and integrating APIs, shared services and cross-product platform capabilities
  • Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational database architecture, data modeling and performance considerations
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and modern deployment environments such as AWS, containers and Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of application performance, profiling, debugging and reliability engineering
  • Experience evaluating architectural trade-offs involving scalability, resiliency, maintainability and developer velocity
  • Proven ability to work across multiple engineering teams and influence technical decisions without direct authority
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to engineers, Product and leadership
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to use modern AI-assisted development tools effectively for research, architecture, coding and technical analysis
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience architecting browser extensions, desktop applications or client-side security platforms
  • Experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks such as React
  • Experience with backend technologies such as Java, Kotlin, Rust, C++, Go or similar languages
  • Familiarity with browser security models, extension architecture, CORS and web application security
  • Experience with endpoint security, operating system integrations or native client development
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, automated testing and secure software supply chain practices
  • Experience with observability platforms, performance testing and production diagnostics
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards, analytics platforms or enterprise product requirements
  • Experience working across AI-enabled product initiatives, agentic systems or modern AI development workflows

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

1. Data We Collect

Information You provide:

  • Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter
  • Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility
  • Application responses and uploaded documents

Information We generate:

  • Interview notes, assessments, communications
  • Scheduling information

Information From Others:

  • Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile
  • References (with your consent, before final offer)
  • Public professional profiles
  • Background verification (post offer)

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

  • We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Assess your application and suitability
  • Manage interviews and recruitment workflow
  • Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)
  • Comply with employment law obligations

3. Legal Basis

  • Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)
  • Contracting steps (for progressed candidates)
  • Legal and regulatory compliance obligations; explicit consent where required

4. Who We Share Information With

Internal:

  • HR, hiring managers, interviewers*, IT support for system administration

*Note - diversity and equal opportunity data is not shared with hiring managers.

Third Parties:

Service providers who assist with:

  • Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers
  • Background verification vendors (post offer)
  • Recruitment agencies (where applicable)
  • Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

5. International Transfers

Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws.

6. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.

7. Retention

We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it.

Exceptions:

  • You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention)
  • You're hired (transfers to employee records)

8. Your Rights

You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:

  • Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements
  • Object to or restrict processing
  • Withdraw consent (where applicable)
  • Request data portability
  • Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law. 

When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.

9. Automated Decisions

Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.

10. Contact - Candidates can send privacy questions to: privacy@keepersecurity.com

data.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer - Dev Platform
data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The Team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Dev Platform team builds the internal platform that Kraken's engineers use to build, ship and run software. Within Dev Platform, the AI Gateway is Kraken's company-wide LLM gateway: a single, governed entry point that gives teams self-service access to leading models from providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI and Google, with visibility into usage and cost, configurable budgets and rate limits, and routing across models and providers for efficiency and resilience.

The Opportunity

  • Own the reliability, availability and performance of the AI Gateway as a production-critical service used across the company, including SLOs, error budgets and on-call practices

  • Design the gateway's resilience: multi-provider routing, failover, retries, rate limiting and graceful degradation when an upstream model provider is slow or unavailable

  • Set the technical direction for gateway architecture, capacity planning and scaling as LLM traffic grows and more workloads move onto the gateway

  • Build observability for LLM traffic, covering latency, errors, token usage and cost, attributed by team and use case

  • Partner with Security, Finance and AI governance stakeholders to put access controls, budgets, audit logging and data-handling requirements into the platform

  • Lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews, and turn what you learn into lasting reliability improvements

  • Automate operations through infrastructure as code, safe deployments and progressive rollouts

  • Mentor engineers and raise the operating standard across Dev Platform

Skills You Should HODL

  • Extensive experience in site reliability, infrastructure or platform engineering, with a track record of owning high-traffic, business-critical services in production

  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes, a major cloud provider and infrastructure as code (for example Terraform)

  • Strong command of SLOs, observability and incident management, and the judgment to know which reliability work matters most

  • Proficiency in a language such as Rust or Python, and comfort reading and contributing to a production service's codebase

  • Experience with API gateways, reverse proxies or traffic management: load balancing, rate limiting, failover and caching

  • Experience with Consul and Vault for service discovery, configuration and secrets management

  • Working knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms for internal platforms and APIs, such as OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, mTLS and API keys, and how to apply them to a multi-tenant service

  • Experience with model evaluations: building or operating eval pipelines to compare models, prompts and agents, and to catch quality regressions before and after rollout

  • Familiarity with coding agents and agent harnesses (for example OpenHands, Claude Code or similar), including running them safely in sandboxed environments for engineering teams

  • Experience with agent memory systems and the databases behind them (vector stores, search, relational and key-value stores), and operating them reliably

  • Staff-level influence: you set direction across teams, write clear design documents and bring others with you

  • Good judgment balancing reliability, cost and developer velocity for internal customers


Nice to Haves

  • Experience operating LLM gateways or integrating LLM provider APIs at scale (streaming, token-based rate limiting, model routing, caching)

  • Experience hosting and serving models yourself, including vLLM, and running distributed inference or training workloads with Ray (GPU scheduling, batching, autoscaling, cost per token)

  • Experience designing, developing and maintaining Kubernetes controllers and operators (for example with controller-runtime or kubebuilder), including CRDs, reconciliation loops and safe upgrades

  • Experience with cost attribution, budgeting or FinOps for usage-based services

  • Background in security-sensitive or regulated environments such as financial services or crypto

  • Contributions to open-source gateway, proxy or observability projects

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

experience_requirements.text: 7+ years of experience with Microsoft SQL Server database administration, development, or engineering
3+ years of hands-on experience with Azure SQL Database and/or Azure SQL Managed Instance in production environments

data.description:
Description

About Our Team

Our employees thrive in a culture that's fast-paced and ego-free, where innovation and collaboration are encouraged at every turn. We are an organization that provides federal agencies instant access to experienced and talented professionals who understand their unique challenges and know the most efficient ways to address them. We are continually investing in resources and talent, so we stay prepared with specialized teams in place who are experts in creating tailored technologies. Our solutions empower Federal organizations to grow, modernize, and succeed in a rapidly evolving landscape.

We value all voices and want to attract talent from all backgrounds. We're on the lookout for individuals who are passionate about technology and thrive in environments where problem-solving is approached with creativity and enthusiasm. If you're someone who enjoys continuously expanding your skill set while tackling real-world business problems, you'll feel right at home with us. Veterans and military spouses are especially encouraged to bring your unique and valuable experience to our team.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Azure SQL DB SME to serve as the technical authority for the design, deployment, security, performance, and operation of Azure SQL database solutions supporting federal programs. The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on expertise across the Azure SQL family, including Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines, along with strong T-SQL, performance tuning, high availability/disaster recovery, and database migration skills. You'll architect and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available database environments in Azure Government, lead migrations from on-premises SQL Server, and partner with developers, data engineers, and DevOps teams to ensure applications and data pipelines are built on a reliable data foundation. By joining our organization, you'll help federal agencies modernize their data platforms and deliver better services to the people who depend on them!

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Azure VMs, advising on the right deployment option, service tier, and purchasing model (vCore, DTU, serverless, elastic pools, and Hyperscale).
  • Design, provision, and configure secure, scalable Azure SQL environments in Azure Government using Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform), PowerShell, and Azure CLI.
  • Plan and lead database migrations from on-premises SQL Server and other platforms to Azure SQL using Azure Database Migration Service, Azure Migrate, Data Migration Assistant, SQL Server Migration Assistant (SSMA), and BACPAC/DACPAC tooling.
  • Design and implement scalable, secure, and efficient data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF).
  • Develop and optimize ETL processes to ingest, transform, and store data in Azure Data Lake, SQL, and Synapse Analytics.
  • Write, review, and optimize complex T-SQL, including stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, and indexing strategies.
  • Design and maintain relational data models and database schemas that support application, reporting, and analytics workloads.
  • Implement database security best practices, including Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) authentication, managed identities, RBAC, Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Always Encrypted, Dynamic Data Masking, Row-Level Security, SQL auditing, Private Link/private endpoints, firewall rules, and Azure Key Vault.
  • Manage capacity planning, scaling, and cost optimization across Azure SQL resources, including reserved capacity and right-sizing recommendations.
  • Automate database maintenance and operational tasks using Elastic Jobs, SQL Agent (Managed Instance), Azure Automation, and PowerShell.
  • Implement database DevOps practices, including SQL Database Projects, SqlPackage, schema versioning, and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Support integration of Azure SQL with Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, and Power BI for data movement, reporting, and analytics.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve database incidents, including blocking, deadlocks, connectivity issues, and resource contention, and conduct root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, architects, data engineers, and DevOps teams, and participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, design reviews, and code reviews.
  • Document database architecture, configurations, runbooks, standards, and best practices, and mentor team members on Azure SQL capabilities.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of experience with Microsoft SQL Server database administration, development, or engineering.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Azure SQL Database and/or Azure SQL Managed Instance in production environments.
  • Expert-level T-SQL skills, including query optimization, indexing, and database performance tuning.
  • Deep understanding of Azure SQL deployment options, service tiers (General Purpose, Business Critical, Hyperscale), and purchasing models (vCore, DTU, serverless).
  • Experience with performance troubleshooting tools such as Query Store, DMVs, Extended Events, and execution plan analysis.
  • Experience migrating SQL Server schemas and data to Azure using Azure Database Migration Service, Data Migration Assistant, or similar tools.
  • Strong knowledge of Azure SQL security features, including Microsoft Entra ID authentication, TDE, Always Encrypted, auditing, Private Link, and Key Vault.
  • Proficiency with SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) and Visual Studio Code with the MSSQL extension.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Azure CLI, and Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, ARM, or Terraform).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for databases using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and SAFe methodologies.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability/Fitness determination based on client requirements.
  • Careful, reliable, and detail-oriented when performing high-impact administration tasks.

Preferred Skills

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300).
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700) or Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900).
  • Experience with Azure Government Cloud and federal compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP High, NIST 800-53, and DISA STIGs.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric (including mirroring), and Power BI integration.
  • Experience with Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, or other Azure data platforms.
  • Familiarity with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), including SSIS in Azure Data Factory.
  • Experience with Azure SQL features such as ledger tables, elastic pools, elastic query, and Azure SQL Database Hyperscale.
  • Knowledge of application authorization methods for applications and APIs connecting to Azure SQL (e.g., managed identities, service principals, OAuth).
  • Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs or other federal agencies.

data.description:
We Are

Accenture is recognized as a global leader in AI and cloud transformation, helping businesses across industries design, build, and operationalize AI at enterprise scale.

Technology Strategy & Transformation (TS&T) - Digital Foundations builds innovative AI solutions that turn strategy into production. We Advise, Design, Build and operationalize AI solutions to deliver tangible, real results - on programs that affect how entire industries operate. Our work spans agentic AI architecture, composable and event-driven platforms, AI-assisted engineering, and the operating models and business cases that make AI adoption durable.

You Are

A hands-on technologist with the range to operate across design, delivery, and client work within complex transformation programs. You understand how enterprise IT organizations work and bring the drive to translate that understanding into AI solutions that ship and deliver value.

The Work

AI is reshaping what enterprises can build, how fast they can move, and where competitive advantage comes from. Capturing that opportunity requires architecture that holds at estate scale, engineering that ships to production, and the leadership to connect both to measurable business outcomes.

As a Manager, you lead solution design and workstream delivery within transformation programs, develop client relationships, and own architecture decisions from design through to production:

  • Design and architect AI solutions: Design multi-agent systems (planning, execution, evaluation, and coordination roles), LLM integrations, and RAG pipelines on vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate), and own those decisions through to production delivery. Build with LLM APIs (Claude/Anthropic, GPT-4), prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom orchestration built for production). Design and implement MCP Server/Client. Judge where AI adds value in an enterprise context and where it does not.
  • Own AI quality and observability: Apply LLM tracing, failure mode analysis, LLMOps, and prompt versioning. Run AI evaluation, quality assurance, risk assessment, and compliance for enterprise AI deployments.
  • Design and enable the foundation for agentic transformation: Own solution-level architecture on technology or AI programs. Define integration patterns (microservices, event-driven design, API-led integration, with containerization and orchestration on Docker and Kubernetes and streaming on Kafka, Kinesis, or EventBridge where the solution needs them), data flows, and data foundations (knowledge graphs and graph databases such as Neo4j and Neptune, ontologies, data integration patterns, semantic layers). Fit the solution into major enterprise platforms (ERP, CRM, data platforms, cloud infrastructure), the core services and deployment patterns of AWS, Azure, and GCP, and the operating model structures that make AI adoption work in practice, not just on paper.
  • Apply AI-assisted engineering: Use AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and AI-augmented development workflows hands-on, and set how they change delivery speed and engineering governance.
  • Advise and contribute to the business case: Translate client requirements into architecture decisions and communicate the reasoning, with solution design and architecture documentation. Contribute to ROI and efficiency estimation, token cost modeling, spend optimization, and business cases for AI investments, and show how cost structure shapes architecture choices.
  • Lead workstream delivery: Own a delivery workstream end-to-end: scope, tasks, dependencies, risk management, and reporting to program leadership. Track delivery commitments, surface blockers early, and coordinate across team members.
  • Develop client relationships: Build trusted relationships with senior manager and director-level client stakeholders. Communicate technical decisions clearly, structure problems into options and a recommendation, and bring technical insight and vertical awareness (financial services, healthcare, retail, logistics, or public sector).
  • Support business development: Contribute to proposals, solution shaping, and presentations, and identify opportunities within existing engagements.
  • Coach Architects and Consultants and build the practice: Provide day-to-day technical and professional guidance, document patterns, capture reusable learnings, and build assets that improve delivery quality across the team. Follow developments in AI, architecture, and enterprise technology and bring new thinking into delivery work.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 50 to 80% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's what you need

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in technology consulting, software engineering, or enterprise architecture.
  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on software development experience with production deployments.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience leading IT projects or a cross-functional team.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience building agentic or LLM-based systems (for example multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, or LLM API integration) in production contexts.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience using AI coding agents (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) in software development workflows.
  • Familiarity with at least one vertical (financial services, healthcare, retail, logistics, or public sector), including how its business processes, technology stack, or regulatory environment shape AI adoption.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus Points if you Have

  • Graph databases and knowledge graphs (Neo4j, Neptune)
  • Professional cloud certification (AWS, Azure, GCP) or AI/ML certification (AWS ML Specialty, GCP Professional ML Engineer, Azure AI Engineer)

data.title: Physical Security – Facilities Lead
data.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

Armada is seeking a Physical Security – Facilities Lead to own classified design, construction, and accreditation of Galleons for the U.S. Defense sector.

Galleons are built, configured, shipped, and stood up in months, not years. Defense customers need those units accredited as SCIFs, SAPFs, collateral open-storage or closed areas, and related secure processing environments. You will turn ICD 705, DoDM 5205.07, and NISPOM (32 CFR Part 117) physical construction standards into repeatable design requirements, factory and site practices, and accreditation packages that scale with the product line.

You will be the company authority on physical security for secure builds. You will sit with hardware, form-factor, manufacturing, deployment, federal, and security partners from concept through accreditation of the space. Where corporate facility protection overlaps a secure build, you will also set access control, intrusion detection, CPTED, and guard-force requirements as applicable. Corporate physical security is not a separate program. It is in scope only where it touches classified design, construction, or accreditation.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role. You will write the standard, walk the line, brief the Accrediting Official, and close the findings. You will exercise independent judgment on problems without precedent, be accountable for results across Armada's secure-build function, and direct the work of contractors, integrators, and cross-functional partners without having direct reports.

Location. United States (Remote). Travel to U.S. factory, integration, and customer sites as needed to support design reviews, construction surveillance, and accreditation.

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Classified design and construction standards

  • Own physical construction and accreditation requirements for defense Galleons, including SCIFs and SAPFs under ICD 705 and the ICS 705 Technical Specifications, SAPFs under DoDM 5205.07, and collateral open-storage, closed, and discussion areas under 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM).
  • Translate those standards into design criteria, drawing notes, BOM constraints, and factory work instructions that hardware, mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing teams can build to.
  • Lead security design reviews across the Galleon family. Read and redline architectural, structural, electrical, and low-voltage drawings against ICD 705, TEMPEST, and NISPOM.
  • Define perimeter, access-control, intrusion-detection, and video requirements for secure configurations, including door, lock, and wall assemblies, STC and acoustic performance, and inspectable materials.
  • Own TEMPEST and emissions-security design input. Set red/black separation, shielding, filtering, grounding, and penetration criteria, and coordinate countermeasure reviews with customer TEMPEST authorities.
  • Specify Protected Distribution Systems where a Galleon or site requires them and inspect against the applicable CNSSI standard.
  • Build a repeatable secure-Galleon configuration so accreditation is a productized path, not a one-off for every build.

Accreditation and government liaison

  • Serve as Armada’s liaison to Accrediting Officials, Special Security Officers, Facility Security Officers, DCSA Industrial Security Representatives, and customer security staff.
  • Author and maintain Construction Security Plans, Fixed Facility Checklists, inspectable-materials lists, TEMPEST questionnaires, and accreditation submittals.
  • Plan and run construction surveillance, site inspections, and quality assurance on factory, integration, and customer-site work. Hold general contractors, integrators, and internal build teams to the CSP.
  • Drive accreditation from design approval through inspection, remediation, and operational accreditation. Own the punch list.
  • Support capture and proposal teams on DD-254, contract security classification specifications, and physical-security volumes so bids do not promise a configuration that cannot be accredited.

Program execution

  • Own the security workstream on defense Galleon programs. Set milestones, dependencies, and risks against hardware design, factory slot, shipment, and customer required-accreditation dates.
  • Partner with Large Form Factor and Edge Hardware leads, deployment, logistics, and federal mission teams so security requirements are in the design before steel is cut.
  • Stand up the operating rhythm for classified builds: design gates, inspection hold points, documentation control, and lessons learned into the next hull.
  • Author and maintain Armada's internal physical-security policies and standards for classified builds, and mentor engineering, manufacturing, and deployment teams so secure-build expertise scales across the company.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship.
  • Active U.S. Secret clearance required.
  • Bachelor's degree and 12+ years (or Master's degree and 8+ years) in physical security, industrial security, or secure-facility construction, with at least 5 years hands-on in design, build, and accreditation of SCIFs, SAPFs, or collateral open-storage areas.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply ICD 705 Technical Specifications to construction drawings and field conditions, not just cite them.
  • Working knowledge of 32 CFR Part 117 physical safeguards and of DoDM 5205.07 as it applies to SAPF construction and accreditation.
  • Experience as the technical interface to an Accrediting Official, Cognizant Security Office, or DCSA representative through accreditation.
  • Experience authoring Construction Security Plans and fixed-facility or equivalent accreditation packages.
  • Ability to read construction documents and reject noncompliant details on walls, doors, penetrations, power, grounding, and electronic security systems.
  • Experience with access control, intrusion detection, and alarm monitoring on accredited spaces (UL 2050 or equivalent).
  • Track record of driving a build to a date with engineers, contractors, and government security staff in the same room.
  • Recognized subject-matter expert who has set physical-security standards or policy for an organization and persuaded diverse senior internal and government stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in Business Systems, Enterprise Applications, or related roles with increasing scope.
  • Platform-agnostic technical fluency in how enterprise systems work: relational database structures, data flows, API and webhook integration patterns, static vs. dynamic configuration, and how upstream changes propagate downstream. The right candidate can describe any enterprise system — regardless of whether they’ve used it before — in terms of its underlying data model and CRUD operations.
  • Ability to read (not necessarily write) JavaScript and Apex code: you need to understand what custom logic is doing and assess compatibility with proposed changes, not just know it exists.
  • Demonstrated experience owning and scaling core systems for G&A and/or Finance functions.
  • Solid integration and data fluency: APIs, iPaaS tools (e.g., Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft), data quality concepts, and reporting infrastructure.
  • Strong change management instincts: you bring stakeholders along, drive adoption, and create durable operating habits.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management — able to translate between business outcomes and technical implementation, facilitate cross-functional trade-off conversations, and influence without authority.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for and working knowledge of AI/LLM tooling — and a track record of helping teams actually adopt new tools, not just deploy them.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or implementing enterprise AI enablement programs (tool stack, training, workflow redesign).

experience_requirements.text: 5 to 10 years of experience in management consulting or equivalent roles within enterprise technology, SaaS, or professional services

data.description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

Global technology and creative network that bridges the gap between engineering and design to drive business transformation for leading enterprise brands. They partner with executive leadership to redefine possibilities, create lasting impact, and implement the necessary technologies to power the entire customer journey.


Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to sit at the core of enterprise transformation engagements, directly embedding with client teams to redesign workflows, establish operating models, and drive technology adoption. This is a highly hands-on, consultative role where you will conduct organizational diagnostics and rapidly build functional, AI-powered proofs of concept to demonstrate real-world value. The ideal candidate is a proactive diagnostician and builder who blends management consulting expertise with the technical capability to ship working prototypes autonomously, ultimately accelerating business adoption and delivering measurable ROI.

Responsibilities

  • Map current-state workflows end-to-end to diagnose root causes of operational friction, including handoff failures, governance gaps, and tooling mismatches.

  • Redesign target-state operations for leaner workflows, clearer decision rights, and effective human-agent collaboration to accelerate throughput using AI.

  • Design comprehensive operating models, including organizational structure, roles, governance, cross-functional interaction models, and value realization.

  • Establish performance baselines and build measurement frameworks that track improvement continuously throughout the engagement.

  • Identify value gaps in stalled implementations, diagnosing where technology deployment has outpaced business adoption to restore the path to ROI.

  • Build working, AI-powered prototypes directly utilizing LLM APIs, platform-native features, and low-code/no-code environments to create functional solutions.

  • Utilize working demos and prototypes as the primary tool for stakeholder alignment directly within the client's actual processes.

  • Evaluate where AI practically enhances a workflow versus where it serves as a distraction, advising clients with realistic, grounded expectations.

  • Support the rollout of new tools and workflows, ensuring adoption is rooted in process design and change management.

  • Design enablement materials that ensure new technology implementations effectively connect to and support the intended operating model.

  • Support complex engagement scoping and conduct diagnostic assessments for value capture, implementation readiness, and adoption strategy.

  • Contribute reusable frameworks and tools that continuously improve practice qualification and scoping.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in management consulting or equivalent roles within enterprise technology, SaaS, or professional services.

  • Demonstrated expertise in at least two of the following areas: organizational design, operating model transformation, change management, technology enablement, process engineering, or go-to-market execution.

  • Proven track record of building structured, evidence-based arguments to effectively influence and align senior stakeholders.

  • Hands-on experience building functional AI-powered workflows, automations, and prototypes, with the ability to ship working solutions rather than just designing them.

  • Ability to rapidly scope and build a working proof of concept within the constraints of a client engagement to move skeptical stakeholders.

  • Comfort and capability working autonomously without a dedicated engineering team, knowing exactly when to build solutions independently and when to pull in additional resources.

  • Strong diagnostic mindset with a dedication to understanding root causes and broken processes before jumping to solutions.

  • Deep accountability to actual outcomes and measurable impact rather than just static deliverables.

  • Bias toward early proof, preferring to build working prototypes over producing standard roadmaps.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a forward-deployed capacity, integrating deeply alongside client engineers, product leads, and operators.

  • Experience in large-scale organizational assessments, process redesigns, or large-scale technology rollouts is highly preferred.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

data.description:
Join our expanding engineering team!

We're hiring a permanent Senior Backend Engineer to join our Asset Sales group as we scale one of the most important parts of M-KOPA's FinTech platform. Build distributed, event-driven microservices and help shape what AI-native engineering looks like at M-KOPA.

The Impact 💚

Your code will directly power the systems that put smartphones and e-motorbikes into the hands of Every Day Earners across Africa. We've already helped over 10 million customers access more than $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every service you build helps expand financial inclusion for under-banked populations

🏆 Global recognition: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest-growing companies for five consecutive years (2022–2026)

🚀 Scale challenges: Build backend systems serving millions across multiple African markets

🤖 AI-native from day one: We're actively embracing AI as part of the engineering craft, not bolting it on

🌍 Fully distributed: Work remotely with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

What You'll Do

At M-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end-to-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.

Technical Environment 💻

  • Modern C# stack: Distributed C# and .NET microservices

  • Cloud & orchestration: Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes

  • Architecture: Event-driven, supporting products used at significant scale

  • Observability: Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics

  • AI tooling: Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication

Our Engineering Approach 🚀

  • AI-native engineering: We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works

  • Guardrails as we accelerate: Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship

  • Own it beyond the pull request: Design for idempotency, retries, out-of-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production

  • The Campfire Rule: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them

  • On-call as feedback, not heroics: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

What You Need

We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

Required Experience:

  • Strong grasp of C# and .NET development

  • Experience with event-driven systems - We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)

  • Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes

  • Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour

  • Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)

  • DevOps culture mindset, including on-call/production ownership

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones

  • Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback

Location & Benefits

  • Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours

  • Benefits package, which includes Bonus, Growth Shares & On-Call Allowance

  • Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • Personalised training budget to support your development

  • Home office setup budget

  • Professional development programs and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

Our technology has created measurable change:

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010 through clean energy, refurbished devices, and e-mobility

Ready to build C#/.NET systems — with AI as part of your craft — that create real-world financial inclusion? Apply Now!

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

data.description:
About the Company

The OpenAI Deployment Company (“DeployCo”) is the deployment arm of OpenAI, purpose-built to deliver enterprise AI transformation at scale. As model capabilities accelerate, deployment has become the primary constraint to realizing AI value creation within large enterprises. DeployCo bridges that gap.

Our ambition is to build the company that defines AI deployment. We operate at the intersection of cutting-edge AI, enterprise transformation, and scaled services delivery. We partner with enterprise customers to identify where AI can transform their businesses and build solutions leveraging OpenAI’s models and products. We work with many of the world's largest and most influential companies to solve their most complex business challenges using the latest advances in AI.

People who thrive at DeployCo get excited about ambitious and complex work. We are deep believers in the future with AI. We execute quickly, value intellectual honesty, and obsess over the solutions we build for our customers.

DeployCo is being built from the ground up as a subsidiary of OpenAI and funded with a partnership of outside investors.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will operate as a technical lead on high-stakes, ambiguous customer deployments and own both technical and business value outcomes end-to-end. You will set the bar for customer engagement and deployments of our technology, helping establish the foundation for OpenAI Deployment.

You will ramp quickly toward management responsibilities and help grow a team that can operate under pressure to deliver meaningful outcomes for customers.

You will also help shape how AI can be leveraged to drive real-world impact, as well as how the team organizes to deliver that impact. You will partner closely with OpenAI’s core functions to ensure field work informs roadmap priorities, drives new exploration, and supports safe deployment at scale.

An active U.S. government security clearance is required. While TS/SCI with polygraph is preferred, all levels will be considered. Candidates must be able to maintain their clearance and obtain customer-specific access.

For cleared engagements, build within customer-approved environments and account for restrictions on data, connectivity, tooling, and access. Work closely with the Technical Deployment Lead and customer engineers to establish a feasible path from prototype to a system the customer can operate.

This role is based in Washington, D.C., New York, or San Francisco. Candidate location will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis and candidates based elsewhere may be considered depending on customer needs, access requirements, and the ability to work onsite.

We use a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office and offer relocation assistance. Office and secure customer-site arrangements will be discussed case by case. This role will also require up to 50% travel; some work may require access to secure facilities.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead technical engagements end to end, delivering quickly with sound engineering judgment.

  • Build reusable deployment capabilities and guide implementation strategy.

  • Coach teammates, capture repeatable practices, and escalate emerging customer or product issues.

  • Design integrations that respect the target environment’s access boundaries and approved data flows.

  • Evaluate AI behavior using permitted datasets, and develop appropriate testing, observability, and human review for the customer workflow.

  • Partner with customer security and infrastructure teams on environment readiness, release procedures, and operational handoff.

  • Share reusable lessons through approved channels while keeping customer-sensitive details within their authorized boundaries.

You may thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 4+ engineering years; build production frontend and backend systems in JavaScript or Python.

  • Ship ambiguous projects, choose reuse versus customization wisely, and make calm, clear decisions.

  • Strengthen teams, earn trust, and turn customer learning into product feedback.

  • Have built or integrated software in environments with restricted access, connectivity, or data handling.

  • Can diagnose deployment problems with limited tooling and collaborate effectively with cleared customer teams.

  • Have an active U.S. government security clearance. While TS/SCI with polygraph is preferred, all levels will be considered. Candidates must be able to maintain their clearance and obtain customer-specific access.
